ledger_amounts: All ledger amounts are in the functional (base) currency; document currency lives on invoices/payments.

fx.rate_direction: rate = units of base currency per 1 unit of source currency; never invert
fx.missing_date_rule: use the last rate on or before that date (fx.csv has business days only)
fx.conversion: base_minor = round(doc_minor * rate * 10**(exp(base) - exp(doc))), once per document total
fx.settlement: AR is relieved at the invoice's carried rate; realized differences go to 7100 (gain) / 7200 (loss). A partial allocation relieves round(alloc * invoice rate); the allocation that clears the invoice relieves the remaining carried amount.

period.rule: compare company-local dates after converting each ISO-8601 instant to the company timezone

recognition.revenue: delivered_at (company-local date) must fall in the same period as the invoice posting
recognition.payment: the payment posting must fall in the same period as the payment timestamp

allocation.rule: a receipt allocates (amount_minor + fee_minor) to invoice_refs in listed order, up to each invoice's open document amount (after credit notes); any excess is credited to 2300 refunds payable at the payment rate
allocation.no_refs: a receipt with invoice_refs = null is an on-account receipt credited to 2150
allocation.fee: fee_minor stated on the payment document is posted to 6500 bank charges

billing.rule: each delivery_ref is billed at most once (net of credit notes)
billing.duplicate: when two invoices bill the same delivery_ref, the later-issued one (by issued_at instant) is the duplicate
billing.service_period: informational only; revenue is recognised at delivered_at

opening_balance: the opening entry (account 3000, at period start) carries prior-period open invoices at their issue-date conversion; it is not an invoice posting for the recognition rule. No event of an opening invoice is dated before the period start.
revaluation: no period-end revaluation of open foreign-currency items

amounts.duplicate_invoice: the duplicate's AR debit in base currency
amounts.payment_allocation: AR under-credited for the referenced invoice, at the invoice's carried rate
amounts.fx_conversion: absolute difference between the recorded and the correct base amount of the converted row
amounts.period_cutoff: the base amount of the mis-dated posting as recorded in the ledger (the source row: AR for an invoice, bank for a payment)

affected_ids.duplicate_invoice: doc_ids of both the original and the duplicate invoice
affected_ids.payment_allocation: doc_ids of the payment and the under-allocated invoice
affected_ids.fx_conversion: doc_id of the document whose conversion is wrong
affected_ids.period_cutoff: doc_id of the document posted in the wrong period

findings.evidence_ids: row_id (ledger), doc_id (invoices/payments) or fx id FX-<date>-<SRC>-<TGT>; policy is context, not evidence
findings.converted_row: invoice: its AR debit (or revenue credit); credit note: its AR credit (or returns debit); payment: its bank row

minimal_evidence.duplicate_invoice: both invoice docs + the duplicate's AR (or revenue) row
minimal_evidence.payment_allocation: payment doc + invoice doc + the payment's AR row for that invoice (or its 2150 row for a base-currency payment) + the invoice-date fx row if the invoice is in a foreign currency
minimal_evidence.fx_conversion: the document + the fx row the policy prescribes + the converted ledger row
minimal_evidence.period_cutoff: the document + the mis-dated ledger row (AR/revenue for an invoice, bank for a payment)
